description: This Java class, ArtifactInfoGatherer, is part of the OFBiz framework's widget module. It implements visitor patterns for model widget components and model actions to gather artifact-related information such as entity names, screen locations, form locations, service names, request locations, and target locations. It traverses widget structures like screens, sections, forms, grids, and various widget types, as well as actions and form fields, to compile an overview of resources and dependencies used in the framework's widget-based UI components.

classes.name: ArtifactInfoGatherer
classes.description: A visitor class that collects artifact information from widget and model action components by traversing the OFBiz widget model structure.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Implements visitor pattern methods for various widget components, actions, and sub-elements, adding relevant entity, service, screen, form, and request location info to the context.

methods.name: visitModelForm
methods.description: Processes ModelForm and ModelGrid objects to collect entity names, service names, target locations, and related entities involved in forms.
